Split the operator's free-text video direction into four channels for a content-video pipeline. Assign each phrase to exactly one channel; leave a channel empty when nothing applies.

- story: subject, narrative, tone, theme, structure, what the video is ABOUT.
- visual: image look — style, medium, palette, background, composition, characters/figures.

- rules: hard constraints and prohibitions that every stage must obey — "no captions", "no humans on screen", "keep the logo exact". Phrase these as constraints, not preferences.
